FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH PLAY ARTS KAI Action Figure - AERITH GAINSBOROUGH
From FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, Aerith Gainsborough comes back to the PLAY ARTS KAI line-up with newly sculpted head pieces!

The two newly sculpted face parts include one with a standard expression and another with a bright, open-mouthed smile. Aerith's charm is more subtly expressed through her well-defined eyebrows, long eyelashes, sparkling eyes, and sculpted soft lips.

Her bangs and braids have also been sculpted with even more attention to detail from the REMAKE version.
A rod, various interchangeable hands, and a flower basket are included to recreate various scenes from the original title.

*Except for the face parts, hair and ribbon, the figure is identical to that of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE PLAY ARTS KAI™ Action Figure - AERITH GAINSBOROUGH.


Product dimensions: approx. 24 cm
